text:
### Monitoring Methods  
**Automated Rules (Fraud Detection Engine, see [[systems]]):**  
| Rule | Threshold | Action |
|------|-----------|--------|
| Large deposit | >£50,000 in 24h | Alert + manual review |
| Rapid movement | Deposit then withdrawal <2h | Alert for review |
| Multiple small transfers | 10+ transfers to different recipients <24h | Velocity alert |
| Geographic anomaly | Transaction in different country within 2 hours | Alert for review |
| High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block |
| Unusual beneficiary | Transfer to new beneficiary >threshold | Alert for review |  
**Manual Monitoring:**
- Financial Crime team reviews alerts
- Pattern analysis for suspicious sequences
- Behavioral profiling changes
- Judgment-based assessment

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Engine
raw_entities.description: An automated system used to detect fraudulent activity by applying specific rules and thresholds to transactions. It triggers alerts for manual review or automatically blocks transactions based on pre-defined risk parameters.

raw_entities.name: Large Deposit Monitoring Requirement
raw_entities.description: A requirement to trigger an alert and conduct a manual review for any deposits exceeding £50,000 within a 24-hour window.
context: Large deposit | >£50,000 in 24h | Alert + manual review

raw_entities.name: Rapid Movement of Funds Monitoring Requirement
raw_entities.description: A requirement to generate an alert for review when a deposit is followed by a withdrawal in less than 2 hours.
context: Rapid movement | Deposit then withdrawal <2h | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: Multiple Small Transfers Velocity Requirement
raw_entities.description: A requirement to trigger a velocity alert when 10 or more transfers are made to different recipients within a 24-hour period.
context: Multiple small transfers | 10+ transfers to different recipients <24h | Velocity alert

raw_entities.name: Geographic Anomaly Monitoring Requirement
raw_entities.description: A requirement to generate an alert for review when a transaction occurs in a different country within 2 hours of a previous transaction.
context: Geographic anomaly | Transaction in different country within 2 hours | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Jurisdiction Transaction Prohibition
raw_entities.description: A mandate to automatically block any transaction involving a sanctioned country.
context: High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block

raw_entities.name: Unusual Beneficiary Monitoring Requirement
raw_entities.description: A requirement to generate an alert for review when a transfer to a new beneficiary exceeds the established threshold.
context: Unusual beneficiary | Transfer to new beneficiary >threshold | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: The team responsible for conducting manual reviews of alerts, performing pattern analysis for suspicious sequences, behavioral profiling, and judgment-based assessments.

raw_entities.name: Manual Monitoring Process
raw_entities.description: The operational process of reviewing automated alerts and applying human judgment through pattern analysis and behavioral profiling to identify suspicious activity.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Violation Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk associated with processing transactions involving sanctioned countries, mitigated by automatic blocking controls.
context: High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Transaction Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of financial loss or crime characterized by rapid movement of funds, velocity anomalies, or geographic inconsistencies.
